2026-10-07PCHMuseums ActDesignation of the interim Director of the Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21Approval of the designation of Michele McKenzie of Waverley, Nova Scotia, to act as Director of the Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21, to hold office during pleasure for a term of two years, or until she is no longer required to act as Director, whichever occurs first, effective March 18, 2027.N/A
subject: Designation of the interim Director of the Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21
precis: Approval of the designation of Michele McKenzie of Waverley, Nova Scotia, to act as Director of the Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21, to hold office during pleasure for a term of two years, or until she is no longer required to act as Director, whichever occurs first, effective March 18, 2027.
